item.text: I’ll create the requested artifact file with the heading and a short sentence.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "mkdir -p .chorus/artifacts/probe && cat > .chorus/artifacts/probe/hello.md <<'EOF'
# Probe artifact

This is a short probe sentence.
EOF"
